documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.text: Our consulting operations team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's consulting operations team is exploring options but has not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This creates operational friction in terms of unclear needs and lack of ownership, as stated in the customer note. The account is in the 'nurture' stage with verified consent, but the lack of clarity on requirements prevents further action.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your consulting operations team is exploring options, but there is currently no identified requirement or project owner. To help move forward, could you clarify what specific needs or goals you are looking to address with Cedar Systems? This will allow us to better align our offerings with your priorities and schedule a discovery meeting if appropriate.
questions: What specific needs or goals are you looking to address with Cedar Systems?
